---
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    theorem-appearance: fancy
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          # proof-like frames use the tertiary fancy colours and a bold header
          - 'make-frame\((\r\n?|\n)\s*"proof",(\r\n?|\n)\s*text\(weight: "bold", "Proof"\),'
          - 'make-frame\((\r\n?|\n)\s*"remark",(\r\n?|\n)\s*text\(weight: "bold", "Remark"\),'
          - 'get-border-color: get-tertiary-border-color'
          - '#proof\(number: "", get-prefix: \(\.\.args\) => text\(weight: "bold", "Proof"\)\)\['
          - '#remark\(\)\['
        -
          - "simple-proof-render"
          - "clouds-render"
          - "rainbow-render"
      ensurePdfRegexMatches:
        -
          - "Proof"
          - "Remark 1"
        -
          - "Proof 1"
          - "Remark 2"
---

::: {.proof}
An unnumbered proof.
:::

::: {.remark}
An unnumbered remark.
:::

::: {#rem-a}
A numbered remark.
:::

See @rem-a.
